title: Final Resistance Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for resistance R.

title: Use of Ohm's Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Ohm's law in the context of the problem.

title: Gauss' Law Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate the use of Gauss' law to derive the electric field.

title: Assumptions Stated
description: Important Criteria: The student should clearly state the assumptions made about the conductors and material.

title: Integration Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show the integration steps used to find the potential difference.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the integration.

title: Spherical Symmetry
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the importance of spherical symmetry in the problem.
